simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to קַיָּם (H7011) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: קַיָּם (qayâm) means permanent (as rising firmly) First listed occurrence: Dan 4 23.

definitions.full: H7011. qayyam קַיָּם adjective enduring (compare Nabataean קים (Cooke 217 Lzb קָיֵם ; SAC, privately, probably קַיָּם )); — absolute ׳ק Dan 6:27 (of God, so often ᵑ7 , Late Hebrew, compare Dr); feminine singular קַיָּמָה 4:23 (of kingdom).
